decisions.reason: The IMU module is a core building block with low carrying cost, and the growing firm has enough slack that no shortfall triggers search for other uses of the resources.
The industrial AC voltage input module has its own page and serves the targeted industrial users, so its results likely meet aspirations.
The four-channel solid state relay is a low-cost extension of the established offer that in-house production can easily carry.
The server room monitoring kit bundles existing modules at little extra cost, though the migration to newer connectors and standalone controllers raises some chance it is revised or retired.
The RGB LED control module is a recent, inexpensive addition to the building-block system, and slack allows time for its results to build.
The remote access service for wallboxes supports the strategic expansion of charging and energy management, so the firm will carry it while adoption grows.
